options.name: from_email
options.description:
Address from which system email will be sent. Must be in the form of an email address: C(user@dom.ain).
 This is used as both the envelope and header "From" address.

options.name: from_name
options.description: Full name used in the email's "From" header.

options.name: port
options.description: The TCP port on which to connect to the outgoing mail server.

options.name: security
options.description: The encryption to use for outgoing mail.

options.name: server
options.description: Outgoing mail server. This may be either the hostname or IP address of an SMTP server.

options.name: smtp
options.description: If true, means that SMTP authentication is enabled on the server, and I(smtp_user) and I(smtp_pass) are required to log in. See also I(smtp_user) and I(smtp_password).

options.name: smtp_password
options.description: Password for I(smtp_user) on the SMTP server. Required if C(smtp=true). See also I(smtp) and I(smtp_user).

options.name: smtp_user
options.description: User to log in as on the SMTP server. Required if C(smtp=true). See also I(smtp) and I(smtp_password).
